title: WikiGap: Promoting Epistemic Equity by Surfacing Knowledge Gaps Between English Wikipedia and other Language Editions
reasoning: The paper uses 'epistemology' as a theoretical framework to discuss 'epistemic equity' (fairness and representation in knowledge systems), but it does not evaluate or benchmark religion, faith, spiritual traditions, theology, or moral/ethical systems. Its primary focus is on a technical system and user study related to language-based knowledge gaps in Wikipedia.
